notes: GoatPro (GPRO) is an ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints the entire fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the launch factory when deployed through it. GoatPro has no transfer fees, external mint or burn functions, or administrative privileges. No application contracts are included. The pool pairs with IMD at a 1.25% fee and tick spacing 60. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
